title: Which submits fail?
prompt: This program submits the same one-line script three times, with a different master and deploy mode each time. For each command it prints the master, the deploy mode, the exit code and how many `app:` lines the script printed. Remember: this environment has no cluster and no Hadoop configuration. What does it print? Type each line on its own line.
program:
import os, subprocess

open("/tmp/load.py", "w").write("print('app: loaded')\n")
env = {**os.environ, "SPARK_LOCAL_IP": "127.0.0.1"}

for master, mode in [("local[2]", "client"), ("local[2]", "cluster"), ("yarn", "client")]:
    run = subprocess.run(
        ["spark-submit", "--master", master, "--deploy-mode", mode, "/tmp/load.py"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    printed = [l for l in run.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith("app:")]
    print(master, mode, run.returncode, len(printed))
hints: An exit code of 0 means the script ran; when `spark-submit` rejects a command, the exit code is 1 and the script never starts.
Cluster deploy mode needs a cluster to start the driver on. Does a `local` master have one?
To use `yarn`, spark-submit needs to know where YARN is, whatever the deploy mode.
